rows.text: The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight rate) at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.
(The following is an English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee statement.)
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight rate) at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.
The domestic economy seems likely to maintain its upward trend.
Exports continue to post robust growth and private consumption shows a steady increase, whereas the expansion of facilities investment has slowed down.
Consumer price inflation remains stable despite the rise in international oil prices.
The upward trend of real estate prices has flattened out.
In the financial markets, there is ample liquidity and financial institutions' lending continues to show a steady increase.
Meanwhile, the volatility of financial market price variables has decreased as international financial market unrest shows some signs of easing.
